message:
Now I understand the flow. The crash is a use-of-uninitialized-value in `NodeId_deleteMembers` called from `UA_Node_deleteMembers`. This happens when a node is created but its `nodeId` is not properly initialized before deletion.

Let me look at `UA_Nodestore_new` to see how nodes are allocated and whether the nodeId is initialized.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "UA_Nodestore_new" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/src/ | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
